matrix.failure_decision_context: Generator mechanical/electrical trip or manual breaker opening while stale telemetry reports online state (u=1). Causes overestimation of P_gen,credible(t) and credits unsupplied energy during 6h survivability evaluation.
matrix.numerical_timing_claim: 30-100 ms breaker trip speed; 1-5 s SCADA polling interval
matrix.timing_meaning: Breaker mechanical disconnect speed and network polling rate; NOT a validated telemetry freshness validity threshold.
matrix.candidate_freshness_evidence: Near-instantaneous breaker trip (30-100 ms). Telemetry staleness beyond polling cycle conceals offline generator state.
matrix.transfer_justification: Breaker physical dynamics apply generally, but SCADA polling latency and network jitter at Nuolja are unmeasured.
matrix.remaining_gap: Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) trip injection testing and SCADA network latency measurement at Nuolja microgrid.

matrix.failure_decision_context: Engine thermal derating, turbocharger failure, or fuel filter restriction causes active power output to drop below commanded dispatch while stale telemetry reports full output.
matrix.timing_meaning: Physical power dynamic transient rate (dP/dt); NOT a telemetry freshness validity duration.
matrix.candidate_freshness_evidence: Fast/moderate dynamic output variation (1-10 kW/s). Telemetry staleness during derate accumulates energy estimation error linearly.
matrix.transfer_justification: Ramp rates depend on engine governor and turbocharger characteristics specific to Nuolja gensets.
matrix.remaining_gap: Polar step-load response and thermal derating response testing on Nuolja generator sets.

matrix.failure_decision_context: Blizzard conditions clog air intake filters or intake air temperature spikes, causing engine thermal overload if dispatched to nameplate capacity while stale telemetry reports full capacity.
matrix.numerical_timing_claim: 1.0 kW / 10 min ambient thermal derate rate
matrix.timing_meaning: Environmental thermal derating dynamic decay rate; NOT a telemetry freshness validity bound.
matrix.candidate_freshness_evidence: Slow thermal derate dynamics (1 kW / 10 min). Ambient temperature and intake airflow differential update staleness bounds capacity model uncertainty.
matrix.transfer_justification: Requires verified intake airflow configuration and ambient sensing setup at Nuolja station.
matrix.remaining_gap: Thermal chamber / intake airflow restriction testing under simulated polar blizzard conditions.

matrix.failure_decision_context: Day-tank fuel line leak or transfer pump failure occurs while stale telemetry reports a full day-tank, leading to unexpected generator starvation during 6h survivability window.
matrix.numerical_timing_claim: 10 s sensor sample rate; 0.1%/min normal burn rate; 5.0%/min leak rate
matrix.timing_meaning: Sensor update frequency and volume decay rates; NOT a safety-credit validity duration.
matrix.candidate_freshness_evidence: Fuel volume balance integration (P_gen * BSFC) matched against sensor reading; staleness during leak condition rapidly invalidates fuel sufficiency.
matrix.transfer_justification: Day-tank geometry, vibration slosh filtering, and fuel viscosity effects at sub-zero temperatures affect level sensor accuracy.
matrix.remaining_gap: Day-tank fuel slosh settling calibration and low-temperature fuel level sensor response trial.

matrix.failure_decision_context: Fuel injector fouling or cold fuel gelling increases Brake Specific Fuel Consumption (BSFC), exhausting fuel faster than modeled while stale telemetry masks elevated flow rate.
matrix.numerical_timing_claim: 10-60 s flowmeter integration window; 25 L/h full-load fuel rate
matrix.timing_meaning: Instrument integration/sampling window and nominal flow rate; NOT a telemetry freshness timeout.
matrix.candidate_freshness_evidence: Mass-balance verification window (10-60 s) between supply and return meters detects fuel system degradation.
matrix.transfer_justification: High-latitude fuel blend viscosity at sub-zero temperature alters Coriolis/turbine flowmeter calibration.
matrix.remaining_gap: Low-temperature polar diesel fuel viscosity and flowmeter response calibration.

matrix.failure_decision_context: Engine block heater fails in sub-zero polar temperatures (T_block < 20 C), causing cranking failure or lube oil starvation upon start command while stale telemetry reports normal block temperature.
matrix.numerical_timing_claim: 10 s NFPA 110 standby start time; 2.0 C/h thermal decay rate without heater
matrix.timing_meaning: Emergency standby start time requirement and thermal decay rate; NOT a telemetry age freshness limit.
matrix.candidate_freshness_evidence: Thermal decay of unheated block (2.0 C/h). Telemetry age > 1-2 hours conceals block heater failure and sub-zero engine block state.
matrix.transfer_justification: Block heater thermal decay depends on enclosure insulation, wind chill, and polar ambient conditions at Nuolja.
matrix.remaining_gap: Sub-zero block heater failure thermal decay test on Nuolja standby genset enclosure.

matrix.failure_decision_context: ECU latches low oil pressure fault or overspeed alarm while stale SCADA telemetry reports No Active Alarms, resulting in optimistic credit for a generator that will trip immediately upon load acceptance.
matrix.numerical_timing_claim: 100 ms J1939 fault broadcast rate; 1000 ms status frame rate
matrix.timing_meaning: CAN-bus message broadcast repetition interval; NOT a POLARIS safety-credit telemetry freshness threshold.
matrix.candidate_freshness_evidence: Instantaneous ECU fault latching (< 1.0 s). Telemetry heartbeat check must confirm ECU communications to guarantee no un-reported faults exist.
matrix.transfer_justification: J1939 protocol is standard across industrial diesel ECUs, but SCADA-to-CAN gateway polling delays at Nuolja are unverified.
matrix.remaining_gap: ECU CAN-bus fault injection logging and gateway communication latency trial.

matrix.failure_decision_context: Maintenance technician opens generator breaker or switches LOTO key to LOCKED OUT while stale telemetry reports generator as AVAILABLE, violating safety governance and falsely crediting out-of-service generator.
matrix.numerical_timing_claim: Zero-tolerance hardwired auxiliary contact interlock requirement (no numerical age limit)
matrix.timing_meaning: Governance requirement for deterministic interlock state; NOT a numerical freshness duration.
matrix.candidate_freshness_evidence: Hardwired auxiliary contact interlock bit must be verified positive (LOTO=OFF, Breaker=READY) before any safety credit is assigned.
matrix.transfer_justification: OSHA LOTO governance principles are universally applicable to energy safety systems.
matrix.remaining_gap: Physical auxiliary contact bounce and SCADA hardwired interlock verification test at Nuolja.
